title: fix(types): integrate public declaration source owner offers
head: integration/public-declaration-owner-offers-20261009
body:
The canonical package declarations failed strict installed-consumer checks because public aliases expanded huge inferred component types, emitted payload names collided with named event members, ElTable exposed a Vue Popper type for its core Popper return, and TableV2 leaked private JSX class types. This isolated branch integrates actual author offers for those source regions on the frozen declaration prerequisites and corrects Changesets keys to the workspace package.

Exact source: 6b735fa3be7b6500de49e79c0a0dfee7cef12b83. Actual local tarball SHA256: 1cc60ea8e3cad4d05806f4024277e650610624344545d0b5e9c270be7fe5e5be. Canonical build/verify, locked install, eight standalone strict motion probes and source web typecheck pass. Installed full strict declarations still FAIL 10 diagnostics, down from the separately preserved 191 baseline. Twelve independent producer TS7056 remain, leaving four missing barrels and six global exports. Source Vitest typecheck also FAILS one imported Table test-d null assertion under the existing strictNullChecks=false config; owner strict producer controls pass. This draft does not claim whole-package acceptance.

Focused runtime: Table/Markdown 22 pass at 84449 with unchanged relevant bytes at final source; motion 2 pass at final source (36 outside selection). Declaration path 10/10, package refusal 9/9, build-utils 2/2 pass. Fresh main 8db0 merge-tree has no conflicts. Evidence includes exact source offer SHAs, toolchain, locks, actual logs, twelve tracked source mappings and ownership proposals.

Related to the issue827/DAG source integration. Runtime, browser/physical-device, published-artifact and unavailable remote CI acceptance remain OPEN. No package publication, default push, merge, security/CSP weakening or alias repointing. Only the root coordinator/reviewer may handle PR metadata and any merge.
